messages.subject: Project Tamarisk — terms agreed, economics
messages.plaintextBody:
Anders, Rosalind,

Good news — we've closed the last open point. Final agreed economics: £4.5m upfront, 4.5% running royalty, £2m + £3m milestones, and a £500k minimum annual royalty from Year 3 (up from £350k, which we secured in exchange for the rate coming down to 4.5%). Liability cap is 2x trailing fees. The royalty model (separately circulated) shows total receipts of roughly £14m over seven years on the base case.

We're preparing the execution version now.

Best,
James Osei
Senior Associate | Whitfield Carter LLP
